args.name: host
args.role: object supplying the member's copied fields: +0x10, +0x31 byte, +0x60, +0x6c, +0xa50 factory object, +0xc58 probe source, +0xc60 probe table

args.name: options
args.role: object supplying only the probe gate bytes: +0x30 and +0x31

args.name: inner
args.role: object whose +0x18 virtual (called with size 0x80 and 0) produces the member object

cleanup.note: Exception landing pad 0x516936b jumps to 0x5169220: frees member +0x70 with operator delete[] when non-null, resets the member vtable pointer to 0x57593e8 + 0x10, drains the member +0x8 subobject through 0x541cab0, then resumes unwinding with the exception object.

factory.note: The +0x18 virtual on the inner object is used by contract as the 0x80-object producer: it is called with (inner, 0x80, 0) and its result is the member. Its internals are not claimed; the size matches the 0x80 object the #2003 lazy build allocates with operator new.

field_installs.value: 0 on the default path; host + 0xc60 on the probe path

install_50_dispatch.default: call the host + 0xa50 object's + 0x90 virtual with (that object, inner); store the result to member + 0x50

known_slot.note: On the probe path only, the + 0x98 field of *(host + 0xa50) is compared against the GOT slot 0x57783c0 (R_X86_64_RELATIVE addend 0x5164750, the same slot the #2009 driver checks). Equal takes the + 0x90 virtual arm; unequal calls the + 0x98 field value directly with (host + 0xa50 object, inner).

install_50_dispatch.probe_path: member + 0x28 = host + 0xc60, then the + 0x50 dispatch above

probe_gate.condition: host + 0xc58 != 0 AND options + 0x30 byte == 0 AND options + 0x31 byte == 0
probe_gate.default_when: host + 0xc58 == 0, or options + 0x30 byte != 0, or options + 0x31 byte != 0

relationships.RE-001-2003-lazy-build: The #2003 shard-member-access lazy build fills an object of the same shape inline (same three vtable address points, same +0x30/+0x38/+0x40/+0x48/+0x5a/+0x60/+0x68/+0x6c/+0x70/+0x78 installs, same 0x541ca90 zeroing of member + 0x8). This window is NOT that fill: it is a separate function with 10 direct callers, it seeds +0x58 with 0x100 where the #2003 fill seeds 0, its +0x50 source is the host + 0xa50 object called with the inner object (the #2003 fill uses host + 0xa58 called with 0, 0), and it alone carries the probe gate (+0x28 install and the +0x98 dispatch). None of #2003's bucket, CPUID, RNG or wrapper claims is re-made here.
relationships.RE-001-2009-driver: The +0x98 dispatch compares the same GOT slot 0x57783c0 (addend 0x5164750) that the #2009 driver checks on the same host + 0xa50 family object; the driver's own loop semantics are not claimed here.
